Method of Attack: Abuses Android accessibility services to gain increased permissions without user consent
Injects itself into trojanized versions of Android apps (YouTube, Signal, Telegram, WhatsApp, custom chat apps)
Acts as spyware stealing text messages, installing apps, recording audio, accessing call logs, contacts, files, geolocation, device info, photos, microphone
Impacted Systems: Android apps including trojanized YouTube, Signal, Telegram, WhatsApp, custom chat applications
Attack Vector: Social engineering via Facebook using fake personas and external platforms
Delivery through malicious Android app disguised as chat app
Indicators of Compromise: Undetected by all existing anti-virus engines
